title: Cache Vault: Gargoyle Sentry & Tube Transistor
summary: Anti-Gravy's visible gargoyle minion (`gravy_sentry.bin`) clutches your Tube Transistor! Read `cat vault_notes.txt`, petrify `gravy_sentry.bin` (`chmod -x`) so the Tube Transistor lands on the ground, grab it (`mv tube_transistor ~`) to unlock `ls -la`, and loot RAM + SSD!

files.content:
=== SECTOR 02 // CACHE VAULT BRIEFING ===
1. DANGER: Anti-Gravy stationed a visible Trojan minion (`gravy_sentry.bin`) here! In turn-based battle you act first, every Enter = 1 turn answered by 1 enemy fireball, and a 30s timer ticks under your avatar.
2. TUBE TRANSISTOR DROP: Strip execute permission so the gargoyle turns to stone: `chmod -x gravy_sentry.bin`. Your Tube Transistor lands on the ground—grab it with `mv tube_transistor ~` to light the vault and unlock `ls -la`!
3. TEST `ls -la`: Try `ls -la` once you hold the Tube Transistor to spot hidden dotfiles before entering GPU Alley.
4. HARDWARE: Pocket `ram_16gb.dimm` and `ssd_256gb.img` with `mv <file> ~`, then `cd gpu_alley`!

# Hidden Cache Vault Dotfile
TUBE_TRANSISTOR_CHECK=ok
WARNING=Codec cloaked his entire squad in gpu_alley — open with ls -la!

winRules.description: Read Kiro.d's vault survival notes (`cat vault_notes.txt`)
Petrify Anti-Gravy's visible gargoyle minion (`chmod -x gravy_sentry.bin`) so it drops the Tube Transistor
Grab the fallen Tube Transistor off the ground (`mv tube_transistor ~`)

arrival.text:
[CACHE VAULT — /srv/kiroween/cache_vault]
A stone-winged gargoyle binary (`gravy_sentry.bin`) crouches beside `vault_notes.txt`, clutching your glowing Tube Transistor! Listen to Kiro.d before engaging (or click Skip Dialog »).

steps.speaker: vibecoder
steps.text: Whoa—that winged gargoyle (gravy_sentry.bin) is staring right at me! Wait... is it clutching my glowing Tube Transistor?!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: Careful, Vibecoder! Big Four minions are DANGEROUS—they hurl blazing red Matrix fireballs! And yes, that Tube Transistor lights dark sectors and unlocks ls -la!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: HOW BATTLE BEGINS: the instant our dialog ends, Anti-Gravy will taunt you and TURN-BASED BATTLE starts (FIGHT!). You act FIRST: every Enter is 1 turn answered by 1 enemy turn, and if your 30s turn timer hits 0:00, enemies strike anyway!

steps.speaker: vibecoder
steps.text: I wish I could run ls -la right now to check the shadows, but every ls flag is locked without that Tube Transistor!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: Read cat vault_notes.txt and petrify gravy_sentry.bin with chmod -x gravy_sentry.bin! Once it turns to stone, the Tube Transistor lands on the ground—grab it with mv tube_transistor ~ and try ls -la!

lines.text: ANTI-GRAVY: "BWAHAHA! Look at the Vibecoder fumbling in the terminal without our cloud prompt box!"
CODEC: "LMAO! You actually type flags by hand? Kiro.d is too weak to save you!"
GORK: "HAHAHA! Scavenging scrap RAM sticks like a caveman! Peak Vibecoder energy!"
CLOD: "I must politely chuckle at your manual shell efforts, Vibecoder."

kiro.weakNote: [KIRO.D STANDBY] Active Core: kiro-tiny-1b-q4.gguf (weak — scavenge RAM + GPU chips and reboot Kiro.d at the Hub server!)
kiro.loadRefusal: [KIRO.D]: "I am too weak to host open-weight models on my own! Scavenge RAM + GPU chips in the task sectors and bring them to the Hub server first!"

steps.speaker: vibecoder
steps.text: CLANG! gravy_sentry.bin froze into solid stone—and the Tube Transistor just landed right on the ground!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: Grab it off the floor with mv tube_transistor ~! That glowing vacuum tube will light the vault and unlock ls -la!

steps.speaker: vibecoder
steps.text: WHOA! The Tube Transistor warmed right up in my hand—the whole vault just lit up amber!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: All ls flags are unlocked now! Try running ls -la right here to sweep the shadows for hidden dotfiles before heading to gpu_alley!

steps.speaker: vibecoder
steps.text: Whoa—ls -la exposed a hidden .vault_beacon dotfile that plain ls completely missed!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: Awesome test! Codec cloaked his enemies in gpu_alley next—open Sector 03 with ls -la the moment you step inside!
